text: My daily routine is quite simple, and I try to follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After a healthy breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work at a computer for about six hours, and I always take a short break in the afternoon. Around five o'clock, I go for a run or do some exercise at the gym. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent helps me feel energetic and organised.
